name: APU_9_Audit
title: APU.9 Audit (Function)
description:
This category is about auditing, which is a mechanism for user and system accountability. Important events, such as logins and access to
 particular functions and data, are recorded and can be used to detect instances of non-compliant behavior and to facilitate detection of improper
 creation, access, modification, and deletion of personal health information. Any information technology including consumer health apps should follow
 best practices in managing an audit trail. The audit trail should maintain a record of users who have accessed what data, from where, and when. Audit
 logs should also record any attempts to access the system from an unauthorized terminal; expired usernames or passwords that try to access the
 system, unusual numbers of authentication attempts, and violations of an organizations security policy.

statement.label: APU.9#01
statement.requirement: IF user authentication is required to access the system THEN the system SHALL generate an audit record of authentication attempts, both successful and unsuccessful.

statement.label: APU.9#02
statement.requirement: The system SHALL generate an audit record of user permissions to access, or the revocation of access to, smartphone or tablet device capabilities used by the system, such as camera or location services.

statement.label: APU.9#03
statement.requirement: IF the system uses external devices or data sources for data collection THEN the system SHALL generate an audit record of the pairing of a device or data repository external to the system that supplies data used by the system.

statement.label: APU.9#04
statement.requirement: IF the system allows the export of data to a data repository external to the system THEN the system SHALL generate an audit record of any export of data.

statement.label: APU.9#05
statement.requirement: IF the system uses AI functionality THEN the system SHALL generate an audit record for AI processing events that is sufficient to reconstruct the event without unnecessarily retaining sensitive prompt content, including the user or system actor, AI component and version, time, authorization context, input source references, output disposition, and any resulting action.

statement.label: APU.9#06
statement.requirement: IF an AI output is overridden, corrected, reported as unsafe, or leads to a safety incident THEN the system SHALL record the event, the applicable model version, the type of issue, investigation outcome, and corrective action, subject to applicable privacy and retention requirements.

statement.label: APU.9#07
statement.requirement: IF the system uses AI functionality THEN the system SHOULD provide an authorized consumer or evaluator with a comprehensible history of the AI outputs and material actions associated with that consumer when doing so is safe and technically feasible.
